questions.prompt: The SI unit of the rms speed of gas molecules is m s⁻¹.
questions.explanation: True — The SI unit of the rms speed of gas molecules is m s⁻¹.

questions.prompt: The universal gas constant has the value R = 8.314 J mol⁻¹ K⁻¹.
questions.explanation: True — The universal gas constant has the value R = 8.314 J mol⁻¹ K⁻¹.

questions.prompt: The value of the Boltzmann constant is k = 1.6×10⁻¹⁹ J K⁻¹.
questions.explanation: False — The value of the Boltzmann constant is k = 1.38×10⁻²³ J K⁻¹.

questions.prompt: The average translational kinetic energy of an ideal gas molecule at 1000 K is about 2.07 × 10⁻²⁰ J.
questions.explanation: True — ⟨KE⟩ = 3kT/2 = 2.07 × 10⁻²⁰ J at 1000 K.

questions.prompt: A gas at 4 atm and volume 10 litres is compressed or expanded at constant temperature to 5 litres. Its new pressure is 8.00 atm.
questions.explanation: True — P₁V₁ = P₂V₂ at constant T, so P₂ = 4 × 10 / 5 = 8.00 atm.

questions.prompt: Pressure is defined as the force acting per unit length.
questions.explanation: False — Pressure is defined as the force acting per unit area.

questions.prompt: The mean-square speed ⟨v²⟩ is the average of the squares of the speeds of all the molecules.
questions.explanation: True — The mean-square speed ⟨v²⟩ is the average of the squares of the speeds of all the molecules.
